# vendor/kit4/

`evidence_kit/` here is a pinned copy of **evidence-kit 4.1.0** (copied from F2's `vendor/kit4`, the version that renders the F1 and F2 Lab Consoles), per the series rule "copy, don't link". Only `tools/build_lab_console.py` uses it; the article builder keeps `vendor/evidence_kit` (3.6.0).
